title: Grandma's Heater Was Plugged Into a Power Strip 🔥 | Verdict Picks Toon Ep.2 #Shorts
description:
The first snow falls. Grandma June says she's fine. Her old heater, plugged into a power strip, says otherwise.

Verdict Picks Toon, Episode 2. Our full Dreo space heater review, with the safety rules and the recall check:
https://acts39.blogspot.com/2026/10/dreo-space-heater-review-2026.html

Facts in this Short: CPSC says never plug a space heater into an extension cord or power strip, keep it three feet from drapes, furniture and bedding, and turn it off when you sleep or leave (CPSC, NFPA). CPSC recall notice 27-054, October 29, 2026: Dreo DR-HSH015, about 338,800 units, fire and burn hazard.
